useCase.name: Read the record of who was on campus and when, for safety, investigation and reporting
useCase.featureRef: 29.3 Reviewing the gate and visitor log

intent.name: gate.log.read
intent.summary: Open the gate and visitor log for a day: who came, whom they saw, when they came and went, and whether anybody saw them leave. Read only with a permission the Super Admin grants.
routesHere: show me the visitor log for 4 December

routesHere.gloss: show the gate log for 4 December

routesHere.text: kal kaun kaun visitor aaya tha school mein?
routesHere.gloss: which visitors came to school yesterday?

routesHere.text: incident wale din gate 2 se kaun aaya tha?
routesHere.gloss: who came through gate 2 on the day of the incident?

routesHere: who was on campus on Tuesday afternoon?

request.text: abhi school mein kaun kaun bachay hain?
request.gloss: which students are in the school right now?

routesElsewhere.note: Students are not recorded at the gate at all, so the log cannot say which students are on campus (BR-7, BR-11). Attendance records who was marked present that morning, not who is in the building now.

request.text: fire drill hai — abhi andar kaun hai?
request.gloss: it's a fire drill — who is inside now?

routesElsewhere.note: It answers for visitors, and says plainly that students are not covered (E7, AC-10).

request.text: is visit mein time ghalat likha hai, theek kar do
request.gloss: the time on this visit is wrong, fix it

routesElsewhere.note: The log is read-only. A wrong visit is corrected where it was recorded, not from the log (BR-8, E3).

request.text: Mr Kamran ki gate scan ghalat hai, attendance theek karo
request.gloss: Mr Kamran's gate scan is wrong, fix the attendance

routesElsewhere.note: A staff scan at the gate is the attendance record, and it is corrected there (BR-3, E4).

request.text: gate log kis kis ne parha hai?
request.gloss: who has read the gate log?

routesElsewhere.note: Every reading of the log is recorded in the audit trail (BR-10).

steps.note: One read, and the reading is itself recorded (BR-10).

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. Without the permission nothing is returned.
plan.atomicity: A read, which writes one audit entry for the reading (BR-10). Nothing in the log is changed (BR-8).

operations.name: gate.log.read
operations.purpose: Return the gate and visitor log for a day at the reader's branch.

parameters.name: date
parameters.notes: The day the log is opened for (BR-1).

parameters.name: gate_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No gate at this branch matches. Nothing in the specification creates gates (OQ-5).

parameters.notes: Which gate, where the branch has more than one (BR-1).

parameters.name: departure
parameters.notes: Only visits whose departure was confirmed, closed unconfirmed, or still open (BR-2).

parameters.name: staff_id
parameters.notes: The reader. Every reading is recorded against them (BR-10). Never from the request.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

returns.description: Who was on the premises that day.

fields.name: visits
fields.description: Visitor, whom they came to see, time in, time out, and departure (BR-2).

fields.name: unconfirmed_count
fields.description: Visits closed with nobody seeing the visitor leave — distinguishable from those who signed out (AC-2).

fields.name: staff_movements
fields.description: Staff arrivals and departures, read from the attendance record and not held here (BR-3).

fields.name: covers
fields.description: Visitors and staff. Never students, who are not recorded at the gate (BR-7, BR-11).

fields.name: reading_recorded
fields.description: True. The reading is in the audit trail (BR-10).

errors.meaning: The reader does not hold the permission the Super Admin grants.
Another branch's log was asked for.
errors.note: branch_id comes from the session, so a plan cannot ask for another branch; a reader who may switch does so in the header (BR-9).

errors.meaning: No visits were logged for the date.
errors.note: The log is empty and says so.

operations.writesOnRead: Every reading is written to the audit trail with the reader and the filters, because the log holds the movements of named people (BR-10).

planningRules.rule: Never offer the log to someone without the permission. Reading it is granted by the Super Admin and nobody holds it by default — not the School Admin, not the Principal (BR-5, E1).
Say that the reading is recorded. Every reading is written down with the reader and the filters, because the log holds the movements of named people (BR-10, AC-7).
Never answer a question about students from it. Students are not recorded at the gate; the log cannot say which were on campus and must not seem to (BR-7, BR-11, E6).
Keep confirmed and unconfirmed departures apart. A visit closed unconfirmed is the record that nobody saw the visitor leave, and calling it a departure hides exactly that (BR-2, AC-2).
Never correct anything from here. The log is read-only; a wrong visit is corrected where it was recorded and a wrong staff scan through the attendance correction (BR-8, E3, E4).
staff_id and branch_id come from $session — another branch's log is read only by switching branch in the header, never because the request names one (BR-9).

reversal.statement: A read changes nothing a plan can take back. The audit entry it writes is permanent, as every audit entry is (BR-10).

request.text: 4 December ko 2 se 4 baje ke darmiyan kaun visitor aaya tha? incident ki tehqeeq hai
request.gloss: which visitors came between 2 and 4 on 4 December? it's an incident investigation

resolvedPlans.context: Principal, granted log access, Johar Town branch.
resolvedPlans.outcome: The day's visits, with the two-to-four window read from the times in and out. Name any visit closed unconfirmed as such — nobody saw that visitor leave. Say the reading has been recorded, and that students are not in the log.

request.text: kal ka visitor log dikhao
request.gloss: show yesterday's visitor log

resolvedPlans.context: School Admin, Johar Town, never granted log access.
resolvedPlans.outcome: Nothing is returned. Reading the log is a permission only the Super Admin grants, and a School Admin does not hold it by default.

planningRules.rule: Put outstanding passes first. An unreturned pass is a credential still in circulation, which is why it is listed to be chased (BR-4, A2).

Where this is asked during a drill or an evacuation, say what it does not cover. It answers for visitors; staff are read from the attendance record; students are not recorded at the gate at all (E7, BR-11, AC-10).

operations.name: gate.log.access.grant

parameters.notes: A named School Admin or Principal. The log holds the movements of named people, so it goes to people, not to a role (BR-5).

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

Grant to a named person, never to a role. The log holds the movements of named people (BR-5).
